verdict.rationale: ClickUp has a dedicated docs page stating that the raw OpenAPI specification is available for each version of its Public API, which directly delivers a downloadable, machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s on guessed conventional paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.) show only that the spec isn't served at standard locations; they do not contradict the documented availability. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation of the actual download URL and spec contents, discoverability at a conventional or well-known path.
